issue_request: FHIR-14149 asked to clarify that Media.note and ImagingStudy.description are not for observations, conclusions, or findings, and that those should instead be recorded using another resource such as Observation based on the Media or ImagingStudy resource.
initial_application: Media appears to have been applied in commit 17a86882a2828780d4c4f2bd3155b8434c7af17f, which added the requested warning to source/media/media-spreadsheet.xml. ImagingStudy was explicitly applied in commit 7b2b64512052c9a800a59b0ac3cd2cd013659b1b, whose subject includes GF#14149 and whose spreadsheet hunk added the DICOM Study Description and Observation/finding guidance to ImagingStudy.description.
additional_context: ImagingStudy is still active in source/fhir.ini and its current authoritative StructureDefinition has later Applied R6 wording from FHIR-47670 and FHIR-47672: ImagingStudy.note is participant-comment text and ImagingStudy.description is 'Description or classification of the imaging study.' Media is absent from the active [resources] list in source/fhir.ini and the resource guide classifies Media as past, so editing source/media would not be a current-spec fix.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Restoring the literal STU3 ImagingStudy warning would conflict with later final WG decisions, and the Media side is both historically present in the old source and outside the active build scope.
